chunks: And by this chain, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever separates from the community of the Muslims and breaks the pledge to the Imam عليه السلام will come to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, mutilated.

key_terms.أَجْذَمَ: mutilated; deprived in a state of loss
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the divinely designated leader
key_terms.صَفْقَةَ: the pledge of allegiance or binding covenant

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kafi say about separating from the Muslim community and breaking allegiance to the Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against separating from the community of the Muslims and violating one's pledge to the Imam عليه السلام. It presents such disloyalty as a grave matter with consequences before Allah عز وجل in the Hereafter.
